recap.paragraph: 56 yards away, Charlie Smyth booted a field goal as the first half ended! The kick brought the Saints within 16-10 in Chicago. Earlier, Caleb Williams had zipped a touchdown pass to Colston Loveland. The Saints began their rally when Tyler Shough found Alvin Kamara for a touchdown. Then Montez Sweat sacked Shough in the end zone for a safety! The Bears held on to win 21-13. Chicago won its fifth straight game and moved to 8-2.
